dict.string: GATIVX reads your daily step totals from Apple Health to show accurate activity even when the app is closed.
GATIVX may save workouts you choose to record.
GATIVX records your route and distance during activities you start.
GATIVX continues recording an activity you started when your iPhone screen is locked.
GATIVX needs background location access to continue an activity you started.
GATIVX uses motion activity to display your iPhone's pedometer step count.
